visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A studio setting where a woman with bright green hair and a man in a white lab coat sit at a white table. A large tooth model sits between them under a UV light. The woman reacts with a wide-eyed, joyful expression while the man holds a UV flashlight. (2) Scene shifts to the woman in a purple satin dress against a clean gray background. She speaks animatedly to the camera, using large hand gestures. Large purple 3D text '牙齒' appears behind her. (3) The man in the lab coat is shown in a medium shot, speaking calmly. A '25%' graphic appears next to him. (4) The woman is shown again with a stylized fire graphic background, her hands on her chest in a shocked pose. (5) A split-screen appears with both characters, then transitions to a full shot of a Listerine bottle. (6) A demonstration sequence follows, showing the tooth model being brushed and then submerged in a container of mouthwash. The characters point at the model to show before-and-after effects. (7) Final segment features both characters holding product bottles, smiling at the camera, accompanied by green checkmark graphics and bulleted text summaries.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video is a highly polished commercial for Listerine mouthwash. It uses an expert-backed narrative (the dentist) combined with a relatable spokesperson (the green-haired woman) to demonstrate product effectiveness via a 'UV test' on a tooth model, aiming to drive consumer trust and purchase.
